reuse_before_create_decision.existing_generic_publisher: tools/qikvrt_zenodo_publish.py only starts proof-bearing new-record publication and its completion path prepares an exact uploaded fileset
reuse_before_create_decision.existing_shared_client: tools/qikvrt_zenodo_actions.py prepare_draft deliberately deletes inherited files before upload and therefore cannot be called for a metadata-only invariant
reuse_before_create_decision.selected_reuse: Import the existing validation, canonical authorization, annotated create-only consumption-ref, secret handling, HTTP origin validation, file redownload and atomic evidence primitives; isolate only the edit/PUT/republish state machine so the new path contains no file mutation call

workflow_binding: none; an exact candidate and separate canonical authorization are required before any workflow may invoke this capability
trigger_contract: The repository candidate binds the exact public before state, ETag, revision, public-metadata response digest, metadata before/after payloads, immutable file inventory, metadata-specific machine proof, v2 prepublication return receipt, and a canonical candidate-specific AUTHORIZE_EXACT_UPLOAD decision.
recovery: Final public_verified evidence is read-only reverified. Any intermediate consumed evidence, an already-existing exact consumption ref without local final evidence, or a concurrent edit conflict blocks automatic retry and requires explicit remote reconciliation.
rollback: No destructive rollback is attempted. If the exact after state is not publicly verified, EFFECT_ACK_DONE is not claimed; a separately reviewed correction and authorization are required.
effect_boundary: Only phase public_verified with the same record/DOI/concept, exact after metadata, changed ETag and revision, and byte-exact unchanged files may set effect_ack_done=true.
